verdict.rationale: Otter documents direct integrations with Slack-adjacent workflow tools (Notion is not explicitly named, but Zapier, Airtable, ClickUp, Zendesk, ServiceNow, JIRA, Asana, Glean, S3, CRM syncs), plus a public API/webhooks and a live, OAuth-gated MCP server confirmed by runtime probe, enabling notes/action items to flow into thousands of apps via Zapier and beyond. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of Slack and Notion integrations by name, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the Zapier/Airtable/ClickUp integrations actually working in practice.
